objective: Slay 6 Gnarlpine Ambushers and return to Sentinel Amara Nightwalker outside of Dolanaar.

description: The road to Darnassus must be kept safe.  Travelers heading from Dolanaar to Darnassus have been reporting ruthless attacks by corrupted furbolgs from the Gnarlpine tribe.
Important news and commerce travels to and from Darnassus by way of this road daily.  We cannot afford to have a rogue band of heathens terrorizing people.
Take up arms in the name of the sacred forest, <class>.  Their den lies somewhere below this vantage point.  Slay 6 of these Gnarlpine ambushers and report back to me.
progress: The road is still not safe, <class>. Travel forth and slay 6 Gnarlpine Ambushers and return to me.
completion: You have served the good people of Dolanaar and Darnassus well, brave <class>. As a member of the Sentinel force of Teldrassil I salute your efforts.
